description: A buffer effect that passes a run of samples through untouched, then records the next run, cuts it into chunks, shuffles them and plays the result back

params.text: Sets how many samples pass straight through before the module starts recording, a whole number from 0 to 3000; at 0 the recording starts at once
Sets how many samples are recorded and shuffled each time round, a whole number from 0 to 3000; at 0 the module passes its input through and does nothing else
Sets how many samples make up each chunk the recording is cut into before the chunks are shuffled, a whole number from 1 to 200; at 1 every single sample is reordered

inputs.text: The audio the module passes through and records
Adds 1000 samples per volt to the pass-through length, and the total is held at 0 or above
Adds 1000 samples per volt to the length that is recorded and shuffled, and the total is clamped to 16384 samples, so this jack reaches lengths the knob cannot
Adds 1000 samples per volt to the chunk size, read once at the moment a recording fills rather than continuously, and the total is held at 1 or above

outputs.text: The audio, carrying the input during the pass-through run, 0V while the module is recording, and the shuffled recording during playback

notes: the module repeats three phases: it passes the input through for the CLEAN samples, records the SCRAMBLE samples with its output at 0V, then plays those samples back shuffled
the gap of silence while the module records is as long as the SCRAMBLE setting, so a long scramble length makes a long hole in the output
samples left over when the recorded length does not divide evenly by the chunk size are appended to the end of the playback unshuffled
one channel in and one channel out; a polyphonic cable into the audio input is reduced to its first channel

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
